reason: The pain is real, I lose hours every day typing openers, but there's not a single result or case study, and I'm not putting my agency's Instagram behind a tool that's never booked anyone a call. Three days isn't long enough to see booked calls anyway, so the trial just tells me whether the drafts read okay.
objection: No reviews and no case studies, so how do I know it books calls and doesn't get my account flagged? Card required and payments final after day 3 means I carry all the risk while 7 other people are the only proof it exists.
would_change_my_mind: A few real agency owners showing reply and booked-call numbers from their own accounts, or a trial long enough (14 days) or a refund window so I can see actual replies before I pay.
